note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#1037 P1.3/P1.4 built-in assistant principal bootstrap. src/lib/auth.ts ensureAssistantBootstrap now reaches the new module src/lib/assistant-agent-registration.ts (this PR), which mints+links the built-in Cinatra assistant principal via upsertBuiltInAssistantAgentTemplate from the @cinatra-ai/agents store. That store's transitive graph pulls the full host connector/agent registry (store -> auth-policy -> connector-authority -> src/lib/generated/extensions.server.ts, and the agents index barrel -> server-actions -> register-host-connector-services). auth.ts is reachable from EVERY tracked route through @cinatra-ai/permissions/pages, so /sign-in — previously a thin pre-auth page that never reached the registry (150) — now statically reaches it. The registration import in auth.ts is DYNAMIC (await import) precisely to code-split this graph off the eager bundle at the bundler level; the route-graph ratchet is a STATIC reachable-first-party-module counter that, by its documented limitation, does NOT model dynamic-import chunk boundaries, so it counts the split graph and /sign-in's static count rises to 1421. No narrow-import fix exists: upsertBuiltInAssistantAgentTemplate lives in the agents store, which intrinsically reaches the connector registry. MEASURED 150->1421 with the companion extension repos cloned pinned (missingCount 0, exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) and deterministic across repeated runs. Absorbed raise 150->1421.
